name: MediaTek Inc.
blurb: MediaTek is Asia's largest fabless semiconductor company, headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. Founded in 1997, it is best known for the Dimensity line of smartphone SoCs, which held approximately 36% global smartphone application-processor market share in Q1 2025 — ahead of Qualcomm's 27%. The company is executing a strategic pivot toward AI infrastructure: it is a production partner for Google's Ironwood (TPUv7) AI accelerators and targets $2 billion in AI ASIC revenue in 2026, scaling toward $10 billion by 2027. Additional growth vectors include automotive cockpit SoCs (the 3nm DX1), a DENSO ADAS partnership, and AI PC silicon. US investors can access the stock via an unlisted OTC ADR under ticker MDTKF.
recent: Q1 2026 revenue was NT$149.2 billion (down 2.7% YoY), with net income of NT$24.2 billion (EPS NT$15.17). The headline event was CEO Rick Tsai doubling 2026 AI ASIC revenue guidance from $1 billion to $2 billion at the April 30, 2026 earnings call, citing stronger-than-expected Google TPU v7e progress and a second unnamed hyperscaler programme in final-stage discussions. Counterpoint Research projected MediaTek will account for 1 in 4 AI ASIC server compute shipments globally by 2028. The 2nm Dimensity 9600 smartphone SoC has completed tape-out, expected in late Q3 2026.
pfic_notes: Operating semiconductor manufacturer engaged in fabless chip design and sales; not a passive holding vehicle. US shareholders holding the TWSE-listed shares or the OTC ADR (MDTKF) should treat gains and dividends under standard foreign stock rules. Taiwan withholds 21% on dividends; a foreign tax credit is generally available on US returns. MDTKF is an unlisted ADR traded OTC and is not subject to SEC reporting.
